answers.explanation: Parallel systems that take over when one fails are redundancy.
Failover: the standby takes over without a person having to step in.
An untested spare might not work on the one day it matters. Test the failover.
Uptime, functionality, loss, and unreadiness are the redundancy metrics in the reading.
Identify, respond, recover, back to a full functional state.
Write it before. In the middle of an incident nobody has time to work out who calls whom.
RTO, the recovery time objective. RPO is how much data you can afford to lose.
RPO is the recovery point: anything newer than the last backup is lost, so backups must be at least that frequent.
Monitoring cuts the time to detect, the first step of a rapid recovery.
